_meta.name: Wan 2.2 14B (image + motion prompt, best quality, 24 GB)
_meta.description: Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B: two experts (high-noise model for the first half of the steps, low-noise model for the second) give the best motion quality. fp8_scaled weights need a 24 GB class GPU; roughly 8-9 min per 5 s clip at 640x640 on a 4090. Steps are fixed at 20 (10 + 10). Output is an .mp4.
notes: Official ComfyUI Wan 2.2 14B image-to-video graph in API format: KSamplerAdvanced 11 runs the high-noise model for steps 0-10 and hands the noisy latent to KSamplerAdvanced 12, which finishes steps 10-20 with the low-noise model.

Two model files are needed, so there is no single Model dropdown; both are hard-coded in nodes 1 and 2: wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors and wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors (models/diffusion_models). Edit those two names to use the fp16 files (28 GB each) if you have the VRAM.
This model uses the Wan 2.1 VAE (wan_2.1_vae.safetensors), not the 2.2 one, and no CLIP Vision.
The Steps box is hidden because the 10/10 split (end_at_step / start_at_step) is baked into the graph. To change it, edit steps, end_at_step and start_at_step in nodes 11 and 12 together.

Faster: ComfyUI's own template adds the lightx2v 4-step LoRAs (LoraLoaderModelOnly on each branch, steps 4, cfg 1, split at 2). Export that template (API), tokenise seed/prompt/size/length, save it next to this file.
Width/height multiples of 16, frames 4n+1, 16 fps. 640x640 is ComfyUI's template default; 832x480 / 480x832 are the model's native 480p sizes.

defaults.negative: overexposed, static, blurred details, subtitles, style, artwork, painting, still image, overall gray, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, ugly, mutilated, extra fingers, poorly drawn hands, poorly drawn face, deformed, disfigured, malformed limbs, fused fingers, motionless, cluttered background, three legs, many people in the background, walking backwards
